youtube_description:
You can still hold onto belly fat in a calorie deficit. Here are the 7 factors outside of calories that decide whether you lose fat or muscle, and how to stop each one from holding you back.

See what you'd look like with a six-pack, free:
https://absbyai.com/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=longform&utm_content=ro11-calories-dont-matter

In this video:
- Why people on the same diet lost 55% less fat when they slept 5.5 hours instead of 8.5
- How two drinks drop your fat burning by 73% for hours
- Testosterone, cortisol and when to get a blood test
- Why a late meal makes you hungrier and burns fewer calories, and how fasting changes what you eat
- The protein study where the same calories gave two completely different bodies
- Why cardio gets eaten back, and why lifting is the exercise that matters
- The Mayo Clinic study where the same extra food made one person gain under a pound of fat and another over nine

I'm not a doctor and this is not medical advice. Talk to your doctor before starting any medication or testosterone treatment.

- Siler et al., American Journal of Clinical Nutrition, 1999 (alcohol and fat burning)

- Cienfuegos et al., Cell Metabolism, 2020 (4 and 6 hour eating windows)
- Lin et al., Annals of Internal Medicine, 2023 (12 months of time-restricted eating)
- Longland et al., American Journal of Clinical Nutrition, 2016 (protein, McMaster University)
- Martin et al., E-MECHANIC, American Journal of Clinical Nutrition, 2019 (cardio)
- Levine et al., Science, 1999 (daily movement, Mayo Clinic)
